as_told.title: Cattle mutilations on the Archuleta Ranch

plain: Near Aztec, New Mexico, a farm animal is said to have been found with parts of its body cut away as cleanly as surgery and no blood anywhere. Two locals tell it on an episode about an alleged crash of a craft with alien bodies near the town. An unnamed resident says it "looked like a surgeon had taken it off. No, but no blood." An unnamed rancher places it on the Archuleta Ranch and says "the ears and eyes were still intact," but the rest "looked like a surgeon had taken it off." They tell it as one more strange thing in a place they tie to the crash.
